context: Ren interviews a man about a citizens' group activity.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: community interview; civic vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この団体の活動、いつから実施されてるんですか?
lines.en: Since when has this group's activity been carried out?
lines.style: soft young man voice, warm professional inquiry delivered carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 十年前から、続けています。
lines.en: We've kept it going for ten years.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 参加者は、男性も女性も?
lines.en: Are participants both men and women?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、皆、自己の意思で集まります。
lines.en: Yes — everyone gathers of their own will.
lines.style: gentle boss voice, soft warm clear delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域に、希望を与えていますね。
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm appreciative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 皆が、その価値を認識してくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm glad everyone recognizes its value.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm humble delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 記事で、しっかり伝えます。
lines.en: I'll convey it well in the article.
lines.style: humble young man voice, soft warm committed delivery carefully
